title: Managed Metrics Monitoring
notes: Scope this row to metric retrieval and aggregation rather than custom-metric ingestion. IBM and Alibaba expose valid managed monitoring products, but their write surfaces are less symmetric than the Core-4 query surfaces.

provider_tools.label: Amazon CloudWatch Metrics
provider_tools.notes: Managed metrics query APIs for time-series retrieval and aggregation.

provider_tools.label: Google Cloud Monitoring
provider_tools.notes: Managed metrics platform with time-series list and descriptor APIs.

provider_tools.label: Azure Monitor Metrics
provider_tools.notes: Managed metrics retrieval through Azure Monitor resource-scoped query clients.

provider_tools.label: Alibaba CloudMonitor
provider_tools.notes: Managed metrics service for cloud-service and custom metric retrieval.

provider_tools.label: IBM Cloud Monitoring
provider_tools.notes: Managed monitoring service with a REST metrics-extraction API; custom metric ingestion exists but is less symmetric than query flows.

neutral_tools.label: Datadog
neutral_tools.notes: Independent managed metrics platform with both metric ingest and query APIs.
